name: Poultry (broiler)

cost_items.name: Poultry shed
cost_items.note: About 1 sq ft per bird at ₹350 per sq ft, Nashik rural 2026 assumption

revenue.note: About 1.8 kg live weight, 5% mortality, a batch every 6 weeks: about 1.1 kg per bird of capacity per month; ₹110 per kg live weight, 2026 assumption

operating_cost.note: Chicks, feed, vaccines and medicines about 82% of revenue; fixed: labour and electricity ₹6000/month, 2026 assumption

notes: Agri-allied. Local mode: 50% of households buy chicken, about 2 kg a month; a chicken shop sells about 600 kg a month. All 2026 assumptions.
